finalJustifications: Because the origin group defines primary and secondary origin: when the primary returns the configured errors, the CloudFront automatically switch to the replica.
Because the origin group syncs the two bucks automatically, keeping the replica ready without setting up the CRR of the S3.
Because the origin group divides traffic 50/50 between the origins, and the healthy absorbs everything when the other is out of the air.
Because the origin group promotes the secondary to primary loop permanently in the first detected failure of the origin.

finalJustifications: Because Object Lock in compliance mode applies WORM: NONE — or root — excludes or overwrites protected versions until the end of retention.
Because compliance mode requires two administrators approving each exclusion, four-eye backup control.
Because Object Lock moves backups to a separate logical safe from the account, out of reach of stolen credentials.
Because compliance mode encrypts objects with a key that even AWS has, making the overwritten cryptographically useless.

finalJustifications: Because S3 Select rotates an expression SQL simple direct on the object (CSV/JSON/Parquet) and returns only the requested columns/lines — without transferring the entire file.
Because S3 Select indexes the CSVs in a internal bank of the pocket, where the queries SQL running with total parallelism.
Because S3 Select converts or CSV in a table of the DynamoDB automatically, serving key queries in milliseconds.
Because S3 Select divides the file into blocks of 100 MB and send only the first one that satisfies the condition of the sent consultation.
